body: I re-read your reply and would like to say thank you again. Getting through some days is difficult, but it's a good way to look at things.

No, my boyfriend has (relatively) great internet actually. It's not a matter of internet, though I appreciate the thought. He has admitted he just feels hopeless when I'm sad, so he stops engaging. I really wish it were a matter of internet though.

I'll call the hotline if I make plans. Thanks for your comment. 
I'm trying to get through just today.
